title: Tiny Woman World 솔로 #046 · 소인 여성 × 파티 샴페인 코르크 · 라텍스 · 라텍스 바디콘(옆 곡선 파임 + 가운데 판, deep-purple PVC) · hourglass bombshell · 기대어 앉기 · 배경 파티 샴페인 코르크 · 로리타 갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, mid 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, blunt bob copper red hair — wearing a skin-tight micro bodycon mini dress of ultra-thin glossy deep-purple PVC with thin shoulder straps, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to her belly button, the two sides of the PVC fully covering her bust, both sides of the dress cut away in deep curved scoops from under her bust down to her hips, her whole waist sides and flanks bare, leaving only a narrow center panel of the PVC about three fingers wide down the middle of her stomach that joins the bust to the skirt, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the left side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole left thigh and the side of her left hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the PVC shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin PVC molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the narrow center panel and the clean curved edges of the scoops, the dress stretched taut over the curve of her hips and glutes, the open slit falling in a clean line, fine pull-creases and a deep mirror shine. Pose: sitting on the top of the giant cork with her legs stretched out to one side and crossed at the ankles, leaning back on both hands planted behind her, chest lifted, chin raised, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy deep-purple PVC, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, in glossy deep-purple PVC with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows tanning oil sheen, golden bronzed glistening skin.

Background: a party table in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic champagne cork with its gold foil and wire cage beside a giant green bottle, giant shiny confetti pieces and curled ribbons scattered around, giant gold balloons floating behind, a softly blurred party hall far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on top of the giant cork with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm festive light with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous champagne cork, confetti and balloons around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
